title: The Maltese Falcon
author: Dashiell Hammett
summary: When his partner is shot on a stakeout, San Francisco private eye Sam Spade is drawn into a hunt for a priceless black statuette. Everyone who wants it is lying to him, and he trusts none of them.
readIf: you like hard-boiled detective stories with clipped dialogue and nobody quite honest.
skipIf: you want a gentle puzzle or a detective with a warm heart.

pairings.reason: Another landmark of 1930s American hard-boiled fiction, with a wisecracking investigator and a plot that tangles fast.
A modern private-detective series with a battered hero and a long, careful investigation, less cynical in tone.
Same disillusioned worldview, moved from city streets to Cold War espionage.
